metadata.title: Building with Gemini 2.0: Multimodal live streaming
metadata.description:
The Multimodal Live API lets you build real-time multimodal applications using Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental. Watch this demo to see how this new capability can help developers build AI agents, and start building with Gemini 2.0 at aistudio.google.com. 

Resources:
Learn more about Gemini 2.0 → https://goo.gle/4gwHlq3
Read our Gemini 2.0 launch blog post →https://goo.gle/4g6G6OD 
Read our Developer blog post →https://goo.gle/3Bl23dQ 

Subscribe to Google for Developers → https://goo.gle/developers

Products Mentioned: Gemini

transcript.full_text:
Okay, this is a quick demo of multimodal
live streaming in Gemini 2.0, and we are casting a tab into AI studio. [user] “Can you see my screen?” [model] “Yes, I see your screen. It's showing a document
with the title ‘demo’. It also contains bullet points
and a Google Meet window with a person in the video.
Is there anything in particular you would like to talk about
on the screen?” [user] “Yeah. Can you start the demo
by just reading the text I highlighted?” [model] “Sure, I can do that. The text you highlighted reads
‘the Multimodal Live API lets you build real time multimodal applications
powered by Gemini 2.0 Flash. It features tool use like Google search and code
execution, function calling, and more.’ Would you like me to
read the following lines too?” [user] “No, can you actually just tell me
what this word means though?” [model] “I can do that. Multimodal refers
to the ability to process and understand different types of data
like text, images, and audio altogether. Does that help?” [user] “Yeah. I need to demo the interruptions
feature next. Can you tell me a really boring
kind of "once upon a time" sort of story?” [model] “Okay, I can do that. Once upon a time, in a small village
nestled beside a quiet forest,
there was a very unremarkable rock. This rock was gray, and it was round, and it sat there-” [user] “Sorry, I have to interrupt you.” [model] “No problem. I understand that interruptions
are part of the demo. What should I do now?” [user] “So we're going to demo memory. Can you just summarize
everything we've seen or heard so far?” [model] “I can do that. So far, we've discussed
a demo of the Multimodal Live API, which lets you build realtime
multimodal apps. And I defined what multimodal means. I was also asked to tell a very boring
"once upon a time" story, but I was interrupted. Is there anything else?” [user] “No. I think we're done. Do you want to read this ending card, or should I?” [model] “I can read it if you would like. The ending card says, ‘start building with
Gemini 2.0 at aistudio.google.com.’ Is that correct?” [user] “Yeah. That's great. All right, thanks, talk to you later.”
